description: Status: Leaked | Revenue: $225M | SACHEM, Inc. is a global leader in high-purity chemical solutions, specializing in the production of precise and pure products for various applications. The company offers a wide range of products including electronic materials, specialty chemicals, and energy materials, catering to clients in Europe, Asia, and America. SACHEM also provides customized manufacturing, R&D support, and consulting services to meet the specific needs of its customers. With advanced laboratories and a strong regional support system, SACHEM is committed to delivering high-quality solutions and fostering innovation
